sprints.name: Order + Reorder + Events
sprints.focus: Order Service, Reorder Service, Event Bus

sprints.name: Admin Surfaces + Automation
sprints.focus: Store Admin, Supplier App, Cron Jobs

tickets.title: Database Schema Setup (All Services)
tickets.description: Create all database tables across all microservices with proper indexes and constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth tables: users, roles, user_roles, device_tokens
Supplier tables: suppliers, supplier_sources, supplier_store_links, supplier_requests, supplier_merge_log
Catalog tables: products, store_products, supplier_products, supplier_product_map, catalog_mapping_log
Reorder tables: reorder_policies, store_reorder_settings, pending_reorders, reorder_runs
Event outbox table template for all services

tickets.title: Auth Service + RBAC Middleware
tickets.description: Implement authentication service with JWT and role-based access control middleware.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /auth/me - Get current user with permissions
JWT payload includes: actorType, actorId, permissions array
Default 5 roles seeded with correct permissions
tickets.technicalNotes: JWT claims must include actorType (store|supplier|platform), actorId, and permissions array. Gateway extracts and forwards as headers.

tickets.title: Supplier Service - Core APIs
tickets.description: Implement supplier registry with GSTIN-based deduplication and store linking.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /suppliers/search - Global supplier search by GSTIN/name
GET /stores/{storeId}/suppliers - List linked suppliers for store
POST /stores/{storeId}/suppliers/request - Request new supplier (creates pending request)

tickets.title: Catalog Service - Core APIs
tickets.description: Implement unified catalog with supplier mapping, search, and caching.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /stores/{storeId}/catalog - Unified catalog with best prices (only mapped products)
GET /stores/{storeId}/catalog/{productId}/suppliers - All suppliers for a product
POST /stores/{storeId}/catalog/map - Manual map supplier product to unified product
tickets.technicalNotes: Only products in supplier_product_map appear in catalog. Auto-mapping happens when supplier adds product with matching barcode.

tickets.title: Inventory Ledger Service
tickets.description: Implement ledger-based inventory service where stock = SUM(delta_qty).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /stores/{storeId}/inventory - Get stock levels for all products
GET /stores/{storeId}/inventory/{productId} - Get stock + recent ledger entries
Internal: createLedgerEntry() for sales and GRN
Publish INVENTORY_CHANGED event on every change
tickets.technicalNotes: inventory_ledger is append-only. Never update/delete rows. Stock shown anywhere must come from this service.

tickets.title: Purchase Order Service
tickets.description: Implement purchase order CRUD, status management, and GRN receiving.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/{id} - Order detail with items and events
order_events logging for all status changes
tickets.statusFlow: draft → submitted → confirmed → shipped → delivered | cancelled | partial_received

tickets.title: Supplier Product Mapping (Auto + Manual)
tickets.description: Implement auto-mapping by barcode and manual mapping queue for store admins.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-map on supplier_product insert when barcode matches products.primary_barcode
Confidence scoring for auto-matches (1.0 for exact barcode match)
GET /catalog/unmatched - Returns unmatched supplier products for linked suppliers
POST /catalog/map - Manual map with audit logging
Store Admin UI: Mapping queue screen
UI: Show suggested matches with confidence
Only mapped products appear in BUY catalog
tickets.technicalNotes: This is the BUYABILITY GATE. If a supplier product is not mapped, it cannot be purchased via BUY or suggested via REORDER.

tickets.title: Reorder Policies + Draft PO Flow
tickets.description: Implement reorder policy management and draft PO generation from approved reorders.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /stores/{storeId}/reorder/policies - List all policies with current stock
POST /stores/{storeId}/reorder/pending/approve - Approve selected → creates draft POs grouped by supplier
Draft POs have status='draft' and appear in BUY tab
Generate deep link to BUY tab with draft filter
Consume INVENTORY_CHANGED events to check thresholds
tickets.technicalNotes: Policies replace the confusing auto_reorder_enabled fields. Clear separation: policy defines rules, pending_reorder is the suggestion, draft PO is in order-service.

tickets.title: Outbox + Event Bus Integration
tickets.description: Implement reliable event delivery using outbox pattern with Redis/Bull.
acceptanceCriteria: event_outbox table in each service schema
writeToOutbox() helper function (same transaction as business data)
Outbox worker: polls pending events, publishes to Redis queue
Bull queue setup for event consumers
Retry logic for failed publishes (max 3 retries)
Dead letter queue for failed events
Mark events as published with timestamp

tickets.title: Purchase Cart Store (Frontend)
tickets.description: Create Zustand store for purchase cart, separate from sell cart.
acceptanceCriteria: Load draft POs from reorder approval

tickets.title: REORDER Screen - Main UI
tickets.description: Build REORDER tab in POS app with pending reorders and policy link.
acceptanceCriteria: Show store reorder settings (enabled, require approval)
List pending reorders with selection checkboxes
Each reorder card shows: product, stock, threshold, suggested qty, supplier, price
Edit button opens edit modal (change qty, supplier)
After approval, navigate to BUY tab with draft filter
Empty state when no pending reorders

tickets.title: BUY Screen - Catalog + Cart
tickets.description: Build BUY tab with catalog browse, product details, and cart.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft orders banner (from reorder approval) with 'Review & Submit' action
Search bar with barcode scan button
Product grid (2 columns) with: name, best price, stock status, supplier count
Tap product → Product Detail Modal with all suppliers
Add to cart with quantity picker (respect MOQ)
Cart footer showing: item count, supplier count, total
Cart modal showing items grouped by supplier
Place order per supplier or place all

tickets.title: Catalog Product Card Component
tickets.description: Create product card component for catalog grid in BUY tab.

tickets.title: Purchase Cart Modal
tickets.description: Cart modal showing items grouped by supplier with order actions.

tickets.title: Reorder Settings Screen
tickets.description: Screen to configure reorder policies per product.

tickets.title: Stock Monitor Cron Job
tickets.description: Background job to check stock levels and create pending reorders.
acceptanceCriteria: Run every hour OR triggered by INVENTORY_CHANGED event
For each store, get products where stock <= min_threshold
Skip if pending reorder already exists for product
Find best supplier (priority, then price, then stock)
Create pending_reorder with suggested_quantity = target - current
Log run stats to reorder_runs table

tickets.description: Supplier app screen to view and manage incoming orders.

tickets.title: Supplier App - Catalog Management
tickets.description: Supplier app screens for catalog management.

tickets.description: Supplier web dashboard for catalog and staff management.

tickets.title: Audit Logs
tickets.description: Comprehensive audit logging for admin actions.

admin_actions table for general admin actions

tickets.title: Push Notifications

tickets.title: Real-time Stock Sync (WebSocket)
tickets.description: Optional: WebSocket for real-time stock updates from supplier.
tickets.technicalNotes: This is OPTIONAL. Start with polling (every 5 min). Only implement WS if real-time is critical.

tickets.description: Order summary screen before placing order.

tickets.description: View past purchase orders with status.

tickets.title: Order Detail + GRN Screen
tickets.description: Order detail with GRN receiving functionality.

tickets.title: Auto-Order Cron (No Approval)
tickets.description: For stores with require_approval=false, auto-convert pending reorders to orders.

riskAreas.risk: Events lost or processed out of order
riskAreas.mitigation: Outbox pattern with retry and dead letter queue
Clear unmatched queue UI, auto-map by barcode

riskAreas.risk: Stock mismatch between ledger and reality
riskAreas.mitigation: Ledger is source of truth, manual adjustment endpoint
Correlation-ID through all requests, centralized logging
